name: VW Scirocco Mk2 GTI 1.8 8v (PB, K-Jetronic)
source: Period VW schedule adapted for classic use (VW specialist practice). Classics are best serviced by time, as mileage is low.

items.name: Service inspection (underbody/sills rust, brake lines, CV boots, ball joints, exhaust, fuel lines)
items.notes: Last MOT fails (2009) included brake judder and binding, ball joints, a broken coil spring and a leaking fuel pipe.

items.name: Fuel filter (K-Jetronic)
items.notes: K-Jet hates stale fuel. After a long lay-up, drain and flush first.
